snippet.description:

👕 Inside Of You Merch: https://store.insideofyoupodcast.com/

Richard Kind (Curb Your Enthusiasm, Inside Out, Spin City) finally joins me in the studio, two years in the making, and it is one of the most honest and funniest conversations we have had. Richard opens up about the vitiligo he has lived with all over his body since his Second City days, the huge anxiety he has never medicated, and why he cries every single day. We get into why he refuses to watch anything he has been in, the day he stopped overacting and decided he would never be bad again, how Larry David almost passed on him for Curb, and what Frank Oz whispered to him at the Inside Out premiere. He also talks about turning down a musical he thinks will be as big as Hamilton, pulling the plug on his father, the way his mother chose to go, and why his friend George Clooney yells at him.

Anthony Michael Hall (The Breakfast Club, Wednesday) joins me this week for a conversation that goes way past the nostalgia. Anthony opens up about the season on SNL he beat himself up over for years and the healing he did not expect to find at the SNL 50th, the note that got him through going method as a general opposite Brad Pitt in War Machine, and the apology he owes castmates who probably still think he is a dick. snippet.description:

👕 Inside Of You Merch: https://store.insideofyoupodcast.com/

Aimee Garcia (Lucifer, Dexter, The Walking Dead: Dead City) is back for the first time since 2019 and she is exactly the burst of joy I remembered, right up until she tells me she died at four years old and has been living on borrowed time ever since. Aimee gets into her dad's disastrous debut as a walker on Dead City, the .0001% chance Jerry Bruckheimer's team gave Lucifer of coming back before the fans resurrected it, and the day Sandra Bullock told her who really hired her on the George Lopez show. Then it goes somewhere neither of us expected, her first time ever talking about what losing Dolly Parton meant to her, the quote book she has carried for years, and the sleepless night that made her face losing the people she loves.
